name: JudgeLLM
description: Empirical LLM-as-a-Judge alignment study benchmarking Groq 70B teacher feedback against a 3-annotator human consensus on financial QA. CoT rubrics boosted Cohen's κ from 0.59 to 0.75, mathematically justifying RLAIF over RLHF. Features a 0.05ms heuristic pre-filter cutting API costs by 65%, failure root-cause analysis, and an interactive Streamlit
